svg.title: Pendentive: section along the diagonal · close-up in context
svg.desc: Section along the diagonal of a square domed bay, with a round close-up of the pendentive: the curved masonry surface that rises from the corner and is part of the same sphere as the dome. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: WHOLE BAY · SECTION ALONG THE DIAGONAL
CLOSE-UP · ×4 · THE PENDENTIVE AND THE DOME ARE ONE SPHERE (R 5.66 m)
SPHERICAL TRIANGLE CARRYING A DOME OVER A SQUARE
SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
